tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Returns current weather for a city. Input: city name as a string. Output: temperature, conditions, humidity.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Returns a 5-day forecast for a city. Input: city name. Output: array of daily forecasts.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Returns the current air quality index (AQI) for a city. Input: city name. Output: AQI number and qualitative descriptor.
